title: 1번 — 영국 주택 시장의 장기 금융 필요성
fullPassage: Houses in Britain are too expensive in relation to income for households to buy a house for ready money at the beginning of their housing career or accumulate the purchase money from prior savings. Most householders must therefore either hire a house, or buy one with borrowed money. Housing must therefore be financed, and the finance has to be for a long term. For buyers using borrowed funds, long-term loans are necessary to ensure that the principal repayments can be spread out thinly enough to be covered by annual income. The investor in rental properties often finds that the yearly rent only covers a small portion of the debt used to purchase the property.
